+          a_level: numbers[1],

+          paper_1: numbers[0],
+          paper_2: numbers[1],
+          paper_3: numbers[2],
+          paper_4: numbers[3],

If `artifacts` is undefined (e.g., when calling the function without arguments), evaluating the default parameter `paths = artifacts.paths ?? DEFAULT_PATHS` will throw a `TypeError`. Using optional chaining (`artifacts?.paths`) prevents this crash and allows the default fallback to be safely evaluated.

```suggestion
  paths = artifacts?.paths ?? DEFAULT_PATHS,
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure readback or report generation functions are null-safe and use defensive guards, optional chaining, and safe default objects when dereferencing properties from potentially missing or malformed input artifacts, allowing the script to fail-closed gracefully instead of throwing a TypeError.
</details>

+function foldBulletLines(lines) {
+  const bullets = []

+    if (!line) {

+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('•')) {
+      bullets.push(line.replace(/^•\s*/, ''))
+    } else if (bullets.length > 0) {
+      bullets[bullets.length - 1] = `${bullets[bullets.length - 1]} ${line}`.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
+    }
+  }
+  return bullets
+}

+function linesBetween(lines, startPredicate, endPredicate) {
+  const startIndex = lines.findIndex(startPredicate)
+  if (startIndex === -1) {
+    return []
+  }
+  const endOffset = lines.slice(startIndex + 1).findIndex(endPredicate)
+  const endIndex = endOffset === -1 ? lines.length : startIndex + 1 + endOffset
+  return lines.slice(startIndex, endIndex)
+}

+function parseAssessmentObjectiveText(overviewRawText) {
+  const lines = String(overviewRawText ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)
+  const ao1Block = linesBetween(
+    lines,
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'AO1 Knowledge and understanding',
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'AO2 Application and communication',
+  )
+  const ao2Block = linesBetween(
+    lines,
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'AO2 Application and communication',
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'Weighting for assessment objectives',
+  )
+  return {
+    AO1: {
+      title: 'Knowledge and understanding',
+      bullet_points: foldBulletLines(ao1Block.slice(1)),
+    },
+    AO2: {
+      title: 'Application and communication',
+      bullet_points: foldBulletLines(ao2Block.slice(1)),
+    },
+  }
+}

+function parseAssessmentWeights(overviewRawText) {
+  const lines = String(overviewRawText ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)
+  const byCode = {
+    AO1: {
+      qualification_weightings: {},
+      whole_component_weightings: {},
+    },
+    AO2: {
+      qualification_weightings: {},
+      whole_component_weightings: {},
+    },
+  }
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    const compact = line.trim()
+    for (const code of ['AO1', 'AO2']) {
+      if (!compact.startsWith(`${code} `)) {
+        continue
+      }
+      const numbers = compact.match(/\b\d+\b/g)?.map(Number) ?? []
+      if (numbers.length === 2) {
+        byCode[code].qualification_weightings = {
+          as_level: numbers[0],
+          a_level: numbers[1],
+        }
+      }
+      if (numbers.length === 6) {
+        byCode[code].whole_component_weightings = {
+          paper_1: numbers[0],
+          paper_2: numbers[1],
+          paper_3: numbers[2],
+          paper_4: numbers[3],
+          paper_5: numbers[4],
+          paper_6: numbers[5],
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return byCode

+  }

+  const startIndex = lines.findIndex(startPredicate)
+  if (startIndex === -1) {
+    return []
+  }
+  const endOffset = lines.slice(startIndex + 1).findIndex(endPredicate)
+  const endIndex = endOffset === -1 ? lines.length : startIndex + 1 + endOffset
+  return lines.slice(startIndex, endIndex)

+    (line) => line.trim() === 'Weighting for assessment objectives',
+  )
+  return {
+    AO1: {
+      title: 'Knowledge and understanding',
+      bullet_points: foldBulletLines(ao1Block.slice(1)),

+    AO2: {
+      qualification_weightings: {},
+      whole_component_weightings: {},
+    },

+    for (const code of ['AO1', 'AO2']) {
+      if (!compact.startsWith(`${code} `)) {

+      const numbers = compact.match(/\b\d+\b/g)?.map(Number) ?? []
+      if (numbers.length === 2) {

+          a_level: numbers[1],

+      }
+      if (numbers.length === 6) {

+          paper_2: numbers[1],
+          paper_3: numbers[2],
+          paper_4: numbers[3],

+function foldBulletLines(lines) {

+    if (line.startsWith('•')) {
+      bullets.push(line.replace(/^•\s*/, ''))
+    } else if (bullets.length > 0) {
+      bullets[bullets.length - 1] = `${bullets[bullets.length - 1]} ${line}`.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
+    }
+  }
+  return bullets
+}

+function linesBetween(lines, startPredicate, endPredicate) {
+  const startIndex = lines.findIndex(startPredicate)
+  if (startIndex === -1) {
+    return []
+  }
+  const endOffset = lines.slice(startIndex + 1).findIndex(endPredicate)
+  const endIndex = endOffset === -1 ? lines.length : startIndex + 1 + endOffset
+  return lines.slice(startIndex, endIndex)
+}

+    (line) => line.trim() === 'AO2 Application and communication',
+  )
+  const ao2Block = linesBetween(
+    lines,
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'AO2 Application and communication',
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'Weighting for assessment objectives',
+  )
+  return {
+    AO1: {
+      title: 'Knowledge and understanding',
+      bullet_points: foldBulletLines(ao1Block.slice(1)),
+    },
+    AO2: {
+      title: 'Application and communication',
+      bullet_points: foldBulletLines(ao2Block.slice(1)),
+    },
+  }

+function parseAssessmentWeights(overviewRawText) {
+  const lines = String(overviewRawText ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)
+  const byCode = {
+    AO1: {
+      qualification_weightings: {},
+      whole_component_weightings: {},
+    },
+    AO2: {
+      qualification_weightings: {},
+      whole_component_weightings: {},
+    },
+  }
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    const compact = line.trim()
+    for (const code of ['AO1', 'AO2']) {
+      if (!compact.startsWith(`${code} `)) {
+        continue
+      }
+      const numbers = compact.match(/\b\d+\b/g)?.map(Number) ?? []
+      if (numbers.length === 2) {
+        byCode[code].qualification_weightings = {
+          as_level: numbers[0],
+          a_level: numbers[1],
+        }
+      }
+      if (numbers.length === 6) {
+        byCode[code].whole_component_weightings = {
+          paper_1: numbers[0],
+          paper_2: numbers[1],
+          paper_3: numbers[2],
+          paper_4: numbers[3],
+          paper_5: numbers[4],
+          paper_6: numbers[5],
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return byCode

+
+function buildSyllabusObjectiveNodes({ topicTree, topicNodeMap, rawSectionMap, generatedAt, paths }) {
+  return topicTreeNodesWithIndex(topicTree)
+    .filter((node) => node.node_type === 'learning_objective')
+    .map((node, index) => {
+      const parentNode = topicNodeMap.get(node.parent_node_id)
+      const rawSection = rawSectionMap.get(sourceRefFromNode(node)?.raw_section_id)
+      const officialSourceRef = sourceRefFromNode(node) ?? sourceRefFromRawSection(rawSection)
+      const objectiveOrdinal = objectiveOrdinalFromNodeId(node.node_id)
+      const sourceNeedsReview =
+        node.review_state?.state === 'pending_human_review' || Boolean(rawSection?.requires_human_handling)
+      const content = {
+        node_id: node.node_id,
+        official_objective_text: node.canonical_title,
+        source_ref: officialSourceRef,
+      }
+      return {
+        id: objectiveRefFromNode(node, parentNode),
+        node_type: 'SyllabusObjective',
+        canonical_name: node.canonical_title,
+        aliases: node.aliases ?? [],
+        description: 'Official Cambridge 9709 bullet-level syllabus objective alignment node.',
+        status: semanticStatusForDraftNode(node),
+        risk_tier: LOW_RISK_TIER,
+        parent_topic_ref: topicRefFromNode(parentNode),
+        parent_component_ref: componentRefFromNode(parentNode),
+        component_code: node.component_code,
+        paper: node.paper,
+        section_code: node.section_code,
+        objective_ordinal: objectiveOrdinal,
+        official_objective_text: node.canonical_title,
+        official_text_kind: 'source_extracted_official_syllabus_bullet',
+        official_text_review_state: sourceNeedsReview
+          ? 'needs_human_review_before_high_confidence_display'
+          : 'source_extracted_no_review_flag',
+        topic_path: node.topic_path,
+        component_scope: node.component_scope ?? [],
+        qualification_route_scope: node.qualification_route_scope ?? [],
+        assumed_knowledge: node.assumed_knowledge ?? [],
+        source_extraction_status: rawSection?.extraction_status ?? 'unknown',
+        source_requires_human_handling: Boolean(rawSection?.requires_human_handling),
+        source_review_state: node.review_state?.state ?? 'unreviewed',
+        source_draft_node_id: node.node_id,
+        official_source_ref: officialSourceRef,
+        provenance: buildNodeProvenance({
+          generatedAt,
+          sourceRefs: [officialSourceRef],
+          reviewState: node.review_state,
+          content,
+          extraSourceArtifactRefs: [
+            sourceArtifactRef(paths.officialTopicTreeDraft, `/nodes/${node.__index ?? index}`),
+            sourceArtifactRef(paths.officialRawSections, `/sections/${rawSection?.__index ?? 0}`),
+          ],
+        }),
+        version: buildVersion(generatedAt),
+        deprecation: buildDeprecation(),
+      }
+    })
+    .sort((left, right) => compareByteOrder(left.id, right.id))
+}
+
+function foldBulletLines(lines) {
+  const bullets = []
+  for (const rawLine of lines) {
+    const line = rawLine.trim()
+    if (!line) {
+      continue
+    }
+    if (line.startsWith('•')) {
+      bullets.push(line.replace(/^•\s*/, ''))
+    } else if (bullets.length > 0) {
+      bullets[bullets.length - 1] = `${bullets[bullets.length - 1]} ${line}`.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
+    }
+  }
+  return bullets
+}
+
+function linesBetween(lines, startPredicate, endPredicate) {
+  const startIndex = lines.findIndex(startPredicate)
+  if (startIndex === -1) {
+    return []
+  }
+  const endOffset = lines.slice(startIndex + 1).findIndex(endPredicate)
+  const endIndex = endOffset === -1 ? lines.length : startIndex + 1 + endOffset
+  return lines.slice(startIndex, endIndex)
+}
+
+function parseAssessmentObjectiveText(overviewRawText) {
+  const lines = String(overviewRawText ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)
+  const ao1Block = linesBetween(
+    lines,
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'AO1 Knowledge and understanding',
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'AO2 Application and communication',
+  )
+  const ao2Block = linesBetween(
+    lines,
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'AO2 Application and communication',
+    (line) => line.trim() === 'Weighting for assessment objectives',
+  )
+  return {
+    AO1: {
+      title: 'Knowledge and understanding',
+      bullet_points: foldBulletLines(ao1Block.slice(1)),
+    },
+    AO2: {
+      title: 'Application and communication',
+      bullet_points: foldBulletLines(ao2Block.slice(1)),
+    },
+  }
+}
+
+function parseAssessmentWeights(overviewRawText) {
+  const lines = String(overviewRawText ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)
+  const byCode = {
+    AO1: {
+      qualification_weightings: {},
+      whole_component_weightings: {},
+    },
+    AO2: {
+      qualification_weightings: {},
+      whole_component_weightings: {},
+    },
+  }
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    const compact = line.trim()
+    for (const code of ['AO1', 'AO2']) {
+      if (!compact.startsWith(`${code} `)) {
+        continue
+      }
+      const numbers = compact.match(/\b\d+\b/g)?.map(Number) ?? []
+      if (numbers.length === 2) {
+        byCode[code].qualification_weightings = {
+          as_level: numbers[0],
+          a_level: numbers[1],
+        }
+      }
+      if (numbers.length === 6) {
+        byCode[code].whole_component_weightings = {
+          paper_1: numbers[0],
+          paper_2: numbers[1],
+          paper_3: numbers[2],
+          paper_4: numbers[3],
+          paper_5: numbers[4],
+          paper_6: numbers[5],
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return byCode
+}
+
+function buildAssessmentObjectiveNodes({ rawSectionMap, generatedAt, paths }) {
+  const overviewSection = rawSectionMap.get(`${OFFICIAL_SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID}.2.syllabus_overview`)
+  const objectiveText = parseAssessmentObjectiveText(overviewSection?.raw_text)
+  const weights = parseAssessmentWeights(overviewSection?.raw_text)
+  const officialSourceRef = {
+    ...sourceRefFromRawSection(overviewSection),
+    page_ref: 'p. 17',
+    section_ref: '2 Syllabus overview > Assessment objectives',
+    locator: 'The assessment objectives (AOs) are:',
+  }
+
+  return ['AO1', 'AO2']
+    .map((code) => {
+      const codeLower = code.toLowerCase()
+      const title = objectiveText[code]?.title ?? (code === 'AO1' ? 'Knowledge and understanding' : 'Application and communication')
+      const canonicalName = `${code} ${title}`
+      const content = {
+        assessment_code: code,
+        canonical_name: canonicalName,
+        bullet_points: objectiveText[code]?.bullet_points ?? [],
+        weights: weights[code],
+      }
+      return {
+        id: `semkg:9709:assessment_objective:${OFFICIAL_VERSION_TAG}:${codeLower}`,
+        node_type: 'AssessmentObjective',
+        canonical_name: canonicalName,
+        aliases: [],
+        description:
+          'Official Cambridge 9709 assessment objective node. Component-level weighting is official; per-question/per-item AO truth is not available from this source.',
+        status: 'accepted',
+        risk_tier: LOW_RISK_TIER,
+        assessment_code: code,
+        official_assessment_objective_text: objectiveText[code]?.bullet_points ?? [],
+        qualification_weightings: weights[code]?.qualification_weightings ?? {},
+        whole_component_weightings: weights[code]?.whole_component_weightings ?? {},
+        per_item_truth_available: false,
+        per_item_truth_rule:
+          'Do not treat AO1/AO2 as official per-item truth unless a later checked source supports that item-level claim.',
+        source_extraction_status: overviewSection?.extraction_status ?? 'ambiguous',
+        source_requires_human_handling: Boolean(overviewSection?.requires_human_handling),
+        source_review_state: 'official_component_level_only',
+        official_source_ref: officialSourceRef,
+        provenance: buildNodeProvenance({
+          generatedAt,
+          sourceRefs: [officialSourceRef],
+          reviewState: {
+            state: 'not_required',
+          },
+          content,
+          extraSourceArtifactRefs: [
+            sourceArtifactRef(paths.officialRawSections, `/sections/${overviewSection?.__index ?? 0}`),
+          ],
+        }),
+        version: buildVersion(generatedAt),
+        deprecation: buildDeprecation(),

+}
+
+function buildAlignmentAssertionContract() {
+  return {
+    assertion_shape: 'SemanticAssertion',
+    raw_edge_exports_allowed: false,
+    official_nodes_are_not_generated_concepts_or_skills: true,
+    accepted_alignment_requires_checked_question_evidence: true,
+    official_objective_text_field: 'SyllabusObjective.official_objective_text',
+    inferred_question_alignment_field:
+      'SemanticAssertion(predicate=question_aligns_syllabus_objective|question_measures_assessment_objective)',
+    accepted_alignment_non_goal_in_issue_1334:
+      'This issue seeds official alignment nodes and fixtures only; it does not map all 3530 questions.',
+    allowed_relation_modes: [
+      {
+        mode: 'inferred_whole_question',
+        cardinality: 'question_to_objective_unknown_or_coarse',
+        minimum_status: 'raw_candidate',
+        accepted_without_review_allowed: false,
+        rule: 'Whole-question alignment inferred without part/step evidence requires review and cannot be accepted here.',
+      },
+      {
+        mode: 'one_to_many',
+        cardinality: 'one_question_scope_to_multiple_objectives',
+        minimum_status: 'triangulated_candidate',
+        accepted_without_review_allowed: false,
+        rule: 'Use when one scoped question/part tests multiple official objectives without numeric weights.',

+      {
+        mode: 'question_part',
+        cardinality: 'question_part_to_objective',
+        minimum_status: 'triangulated_candidate',
+        accepted_without_review_allowed: false,
+        rule: 'Use when the segmentation model can localize alignment to a part/subpart.',
+      },
+      {
+        mode: 'step_level',
+        cardinality: 'mark_step_or_procedure_step_to_objective',
+        minimum_status: 'triangulated_candidate',
+        accepted_without_review_allowed: false,
+        rule: 'Use when a mark step/procedure step aligns to one or more official objectives.',
+      },
+      {
+        mode: 'weighted_many_to_many',
+        cardinality: 'multiple_scopes_to_multiple_objectives_with_weights',
+        minimum_status: 'triangulated_candidate',
+        accepted_without_review_allowed: false,
+        rule: 'Use only when weights are evidence-bearing assertion metadata, not inferred raw edges.',
+      },
+    ].sort((left, right) => compareByteOrder(left.mode, right.mode)),
+  }
+}
+
+function buildAssertionProvenance({ generatedAt, objectiveRefs, fixtureId }) {
+  return {
+    source_artifact_refs: [
+      sourceArtifactRef(DEFAULT_PATHS.fixturesOut, `/cases/${fixtureId}`),
+      sourceArtifactRef(DEFAULT_PATHS.alignmentOut, '/seed_nodes/syllabus_objectives'),
+      sourceArtifactRef(DEFAULT_PATHS.segmentationModel, '/scope_levels'),
+      sourceArtifactRef(DEFAULT_PATHS.statusModel, '/risk_tier_promotion_rules'),
+    ],
+    generator: actor('system', SCRIPT_NAME, {
+      run_id: `issue-1334-fixture-${fixtureId}`,
+      external_model_call_count: 0,
+    }),
+    validator: actor('system', SCRIPT_NAME, {
+      validator_result_ref: DEFAULT_PATHS.validatorOut,
+    }),
+    reviewer: {
+      review_state: 'not_required',
+      reason: 'local fixture proving assertion shape; no production mapping accepted',
+    },
+    question_ref: {
+      question_row_id: `qrow_9709_fixture_${fixtureId}`,
+      fixture_only: true,
+    },
+    syllabus_objective_ref: {
+      objective_refs: objectiveRefs,
+      fixture_only: true,
+    },
+    mark_scheme_ref: {
+      fixture_only: true,
+      reason: 'fixture scope only; no checked live mark-step mapping accepted',
+    },
+    method_map_row_ref: explicitNotApplicable('alignment fixture does not consume Method Map truth'),
+    procedure_model_row_ref: explicitNotApplicable('alignment fixture does not consume ProcedureModel truth'),
+    timestamp: generatedAt,
+    content_hash: contentHashFor({ fixtureId, objectiveRefs }),
+  }
+}
+
+function makeFixtureAssertion({
+  fixtureId,
+  relationMode,
+  scopeLevel,
+  status,
+  objectiveRefs,
+  generatedAt,
+  extra = {},
+}) {
+  return {
+    assertion_shape: 'SemanticAssertion',
+    assertion_id: `semassert:question_aligns_syllabus_objective:${fixtureId}:${RELEASE_ID}`,
+    predicate: 'question_aligns_syllabus_objective',
+    status,
+    risk_tier: LOW_RISK_TIER,
+    confidence: {
+      score: null,
+      score_kind: 'fixture_no_numeric_confidence',
+      reason: 'No model call and no production mapping in issue #1334.',
+    },
+    relation_mode: relationMode,
+    subject_ref: {
+      node_type: 'QuestionSemanticProfile',
+      id: `qsemprof:qrow_9709_fixture_${fixtureId}:taxonomy:${RELEASE_ID}`,
+    },
+    object_ref: {
+      node_type: 'SyllabusObjective',
+      objective_refs: objectiveRefs,
+    },
+    scope_ref: {
+      scope_level: scopeLevel,
+      scope_id: `fixture:${fixtureId}:${scopeLevel}`,
+    },
+    evidence_bundle_ref: {
+      fixture_only: true,
+      evidence_family_count: 0,
+      accepted_runtime_evidence: false,
+    },
+    review: {
+      required: status === 'raw_candidate',
+      review_state: status === 'raw_candidate' ? 'requires_review' : 'fixture_no_review_required',
+      reason: 'Fixture proves the assertion contract and is not a production accepted edge.',
+    },
+    provenance: buildAssertionProvenance({
+      generatedAt,
+      objectiveRefs,
+      fixtureId,
+    }),
+    version: {
+      taxonomy_release_id: RELEASE_ID,
+      assertion_contract_version: 'v1',
+      created_at: generatedAt,
+      updated_at: generatedAt,
+    },
+    ...extra,
+  }
+}
+
+function findObjectiveRef(objectiveNodes, suffix) {
+  const found = objectiveNodes.find((node) => node.id.endsWith(suffix))
+  return found?.id ?? objectiveNodes[0]?.id ?? null
+}
body: Fixed in 8c49cdde0: `findObjectiveRef` now returns `null` when the requested suffix is not found, and the fixture validator now fails null/missing objective refs so missing suffixes cannot silently point at the first objective.

+    '',

+    '',

+export function buildSemanticKgOfficialSyllabusAlignmentLayer(options = {}) {
+  const root = rootFromOptions(options)
+  const generatedAt = options.generatedAt ?? DEFAULT_GENERATED_AT

+    ...(options.paths ?? {}),

+  const inputDiagnostics = []
+  const inputs = {
+    sourceManifest: readJsonInput(root, paths.sourceManifest, 'semantic_kg_source_manifest', inputDiagnostics),

+    taxonomyContract: readJsonInput(root, paths.taxonomyContract, 'semantic_kg_taxonomy_contract', inputDiagnostics),
+    officialSourceInventory: readJsonInput(root, paths.officialSourceInventory, 'official_source_inventory', inputDiagnostics),
+    officialRawSections: readJsonInput(root, paths.officialRawSections, 'official_raw_sections', inputDiagnostics),
+    officialTopicTreeDraft: readJsonInput(root, paths.officialTopicTreeDraft, 'official_topic_tree_draft', inputDiagnostics),
+    syllabusGateReport: readJsonInput(root, paths.syllabusGateReport, 'syllabus_gate_report', inputDiagnostics),
+  }
+
+  const rawSectionMap = rawSectionById(inputs.officialRawSections)
+  const topicNodeMap = topicTreeNodeById(inputs.officialTopicTreeDraft)
+  const paperComponents = buildPaperComponentNodes({
+    topicTree: inputs.officialTopicTreeDraft,
+    rawSectionMap,
+    generatedAt,
+    paths,
+  })
+  const syllabusTopics = buildSyllabusTopicNodes({
+    topicTree: inputs.officialTopicTreeDraft,
+    rawSectionMap,
+    generatedAt,
+    paths,
+  })
+  const syllabusObjectives = buildSyllabusObjectiveNodes({

+    rawSectionMap,
+    generatedAt,
+    paths,
+  })
+  const assessmentObjectives = buildAssessmentObjectiveNodes({
+    rawSectionMap,
+    generatedAt,
+    paths,
+  })
+  const fixtures = buildFixtures({
+    objectiveNodes: syllabusObjectives,
+    generatedAt,
+  })
+  const sourceArtifactInventory = buildSourceArtifactInventory(paths, root, inputs)
+  const sourceContract = buildSourceContract(paths, inputs, sourceArtifactInventory)
+  const officialAlignmentNodeCount =
+    paperComponents.length + syllabusTopics.length + syllabusObjectives.length + assessmentObjectives.length
+  const acceptedQuestionAlignmentAssertionCount = fixtures.cases
+    .filter((item) => item.assertion?.status === 'accepted').length
+
+  const alignmentLayer = {
+    schema_version: 'semantic_kg_official_syllabus_alignment_layer.v1',
+    generated_at: generatedAt,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: 1334,
+    parent_issue: 1313,
+    depends_on_issues: [1314, 1315, 1333, 1317, 1316],
+    subject_code: SUBJECT_CODE,
+    objective:
+      'Seed official Cambridge 9709 component/topic/objective/AO alignment nodes before semantic candidate generation.',
+    boundary: buildBoundary(),
+    source_contract: sourceContract,
+    source_artifact_inventory: sourceArtifactInventory,
+    alignment_assertion_contract: buildAlignmentAssertionContract(),
+    seed_nodes: {
+      paper_components: paperComponents,
+      syllabus_topics: syllabusTopics,
+      syllabus_objectives: syllabusObjectives,
+      assessment_objectives: assessmentObjectives,
+    },
+    summary: {
+      paper_component_count: paperComponents.length,
+      syllabus_topic_count: syllabusTopics.length,
+      syllabus_objective_count: syllabusObjectives.length,
+      assessment_objective_count: assessmentObjectives.length,
+      official_alignment_node_count: officialAlignmentNodeCount,
+      question_alignment_fixture_count: fixtures.cases.length,
+      accepted_question_alignment_assertion_count: acceptedQuestionAlignmentAssertionCount,
+      seed_node_status_counts: [...paperComponents, ...syllabusTopics, ...syllabusObjectives, ...assessmentObjectives]
+        .reduce((counts, node) => {
+          counts[node.status] = (counts[node.status] ?? 0) + 1
+          return counts
+        }, {}),
+      external_model_call_count: 0,
+      remote_supabase_mutation_performed: false,
+      production_rag_reindex_performed: false,
+    },
+  }
+
+  const validatorResult = validateAlignmentLayer({
+    alignmentLayer,
+    fixtures,
+    inputDiagnostics,
+  })
+  const readback = buildReadback({
+    alignmentLayer,
+    fixtures,
+    validatorResult,
+  })
+
+  return {
+    alignmentLayer,
+    fixtures,
+    validatorResult,
+    readback,
+    paths,
+  }
+}

+export function writeSemanticKgOfficialSyllabusAlignmentLayerArtifacts({
+  outRoot,
+  artifacts,

+        observed_counts: {
+          paper_component_count: alignmentLayer.summary.paper_component_count,
+          syllabus_topic_count: alignmentLayer.summary.syllabus_topic_count,
+          syllabus_objective_count: alignmentLayer.summary.syllabus_objective_count,
+          assessment_objective_count: alignmentLayer.summary.assessment_objective_count,
+        },
+      },
+    ),
+    check(
+      'seed_node_source_provenance',
+      nodeFailures.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+      'Every seed node has source refs, provenance, visible generator/validator/reviewer posture, and content hash.',
+      { node_failures: nodeFailures.slice(0, 50), failure_count: nodeFailures.length },
+    ),
+    check(
+      'source_lock_matches_official_9709_v4',
+      alignmentLayer.source_contract.locked_source_document_id === OFFICIAL_SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID &&
+        alignmentLayer.source_contract.official_syllabus_version_tag === OFFICIAL_VERSION_TAG
+        ? 'pass'
+        : 'fail',
+      'Official source lock matches Cambridge 9709 2026-2027 version 4.',
+    ),
+    check(
+      'stable_ids_unique_and_patterned',
+      duplicateIds.length === 0 && nodeFailures.every((item) => item.failure !== 'stable_id_prefix_invalid')
+        ? 'pass'
+        : 'fail',
+      'Stable IDs are unique and use typed semkg:9709 official alignment prefixes.',
+      { duplicate_ids: [...new Set(duplicateIds)].sort(compareByteOrder) },
+    ),
+  ].sort((left, right) => compareByteOrder(left.id, right.id))
+
+  const validationStatus = checks.every((item) => item.status === 'pass') ? 'pass' : 'fail'
+  return {
+    schema_version: 'semantic_kg_official_syllabus_alignment_validator_result.v1',
+    generated_at: alignmentLayer.generated_at,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: 1334,
+    parent_issue: 1313,
+    summary: {
+      validation_status: validationStatus,
+      check_count: checks.length,
+      check_pass_count: checks.filter((item) => item.status === 'pass').length,
+      check_fail_count: checks.filter((item) => item.status === 'fail').length,
+      official_alignment_node_count: allNodes.length,
+      paper_component_count: alignmentLayer.summary.paper_component_count,
+      syllabus_topic_count: alignmentLayer.summary.syllabus_topic_count,
+      syllabus_objective_count: alignmentLayer.summary.syllabus_objective_count,
+      assessment_objective_count: alignmentLayer.summary.assessment_objective_count,
+      fixture_count: fixtures.cases.length,
+      fixture_pass_count: fixtureResults.filter((item) => item.observed_valid === item.expected_valid).length,
+      accepted_question_alignment_assertion_count: acceptedQuestionAlignmentAssertions.length,
+      external_model_call_count: 0,
+      remote_supabase_mutation_performed: false,
+      production_rag_reindex_performed: false,
+    },
+    checks,
+    fixture_results: fixtureResults,
+    input_diagnostics: inputDiagnostics,
+  }
+}
+
+function buildReadback({ alignmentLayer, fixtures, validatorResult }) {
+  const sourceRows = alignmentLayer.source_artifact_inventory
+    .map((item) => `| ${item.role} | ${item.path} | ${item.consumed ? 'yes' : 'no'} |`)
+  const modeRows = alignmentLayer.alignment_assertion_contract.allowed_relation_modes
+    .map((item) => `| ${item.mode} | ${item.cardinality} | ${item.minimum_status} |`)
+  const checkRows = validatorResult.checks
+    .map((item) => `| ${item.id} | ${item.status} |`)
+
+  return [
+    '# Semantic KG Official Syllabus Alignment Layer Readback',
+    '',
+    `Generated at: \`${alignmentLayer.generated_at}\``,
+    `Issue: #${alignmentLayer.issue}`,
+    `Parent: #${alignmentLayer.parent_issue}`,
+    '',
+    '## Source Lock',
+    '',
+    `- Official source document: \`${alignmentLayer.source_contract.locked_source_document_id}\``,
+    `- Syllabus version: \`${alignmentLayer.source_contract.official_syllabus_version_tag}\``,
+    `- Official PDF SHA-256: \`${alignmentLayer.source_contract.official_pdf_sha256}\``,
+    '- No external model calls, remote Supabase mutation, frontend work, or production RAG reindex were performed.',
+    '',
+    '## Seed Counts',
+    '',
+    `- PaperComponent nodes: ${alignmentLayer.summary.paper_component_count}`,
+    `- SyllabusTopic nodes: ${alignmentLayer.summary.syllabus_topic_count}`,
+    `- SyllabusObjective nodes: ${alignmentLayer.summary.syllabus_objective_count}`,
+    `- AssessmentObjective nodes: ${alignmentLayer.summary.assessment_objective_count}`,
+    `- Official alignment nodes total: ${alignmentLayer.summary.official_alignment_node_count}`,
+    `- Accepted question alignment assertions: ${alignmentLayer.summary.accepted_question_alignment_assertion_count}`,
+    '',
+    '## Official vs Inferred Boundary',
+    '',
+    '- Official objective text is stored only on source-backed `SyllabusObjective` nodes.',
+    '- Question/objective mapping is represented only as `SemanticAssertion` records with status, scope, provenance, and review posture.',
+    '- This issue does not infer all 3530 question mappings and does not create accepted semantic edges from model output.',
+    '- AO1/AO2 nodes record official component-level/qualification-level weighting only; per-item AO truth remains unavailable.',
+    '',
+    '## Source Artifact Inventory',
+    '',
+    '| Role | Path | Consumed |',
+    '| --- | --- | --- |',
+    ...sourceRows,
+    '',
+    '## Alignment Relation Modes',
+    '',
+    '| Mode | Cardinality | Minimum status |',
+    '| --- | --- | --- |',
+    ...modeRows,
+    '',
+    '## Fixtures',
+    '',
+    ...fixtures.cases.map((item) =>
+      `- \`${item.fixture_id}\`: ${item.assertion.relation_mode}, status \`${item.assertion.status}\`, raw edge exported: ${item.raw_edge_exported}`,
+    ),
+    '',
+    '## Validator',
+    '',
+    `Validation status: \`${validatorResult.summary.validation_status}\``,
+    '',
+    '| Check | Status |',
+    '| --- | --- |',
+    ...checkRows,
+    '',
+  ].join('\n')
+}
+
+export function buildSemanticKgOfficialSyllabusAlignmentLayer(options = {}) {
+  const root = rootFromOptions(options)
+  const generatedAt = options.generatedAt ?? DEFAULT_GENERATED_AT
+  const paths = {
+    ...DEFAULT_PATHS,
+    ...(options.paths ?? {}),
+  }
+  const inputDiagnostics = []
+  const inputs = {
+    sourceManifest: readJsonInput(root, paths.sourceManifest, 'semantic_kg_source_manifest', inputDiagnostics),
+    segmentationModel: readJsonInput(root, paths.segmentationModel, 'semantic_kg_segmentation_model', inputDiagnostics),
+    statusModel: readJsonInput(root, paths.statusModel, 'semantic_kg_status_model', inputDiagnostics),
+    taxonomyContract: readJsonInput(root, paths.taxonomyContract, 'semantic_kg_taxonomy_contract', inputDiagnostics),
+    officialSourceInventory: readJsonInput(root, paths.officialSourceInventory, 'official_source_inventory', inputDiagnostics),
+    officialRawSections: readJsonInput(root, paths.officialRawSections, 'official_raw_sections', inputDiagnostics),
+    officialTopicTreeDraft: readJsonInput(root, paths.officialTopicTreeDraft, 'official_topic_tree_draft', inputDiagnostics),
+    syllabusGateReport: readJsonInput(root, paths.syllabusGateReport, 'syllabus_gate_report', inputDiagnostics),
+  }
+
+  const rawSectionMap = rawSectionById(inputs.officialRawSections)
+  const topicNodeMap = topicTreeNodeById(inputs.officialTopicTreeDraft)
+  const paperComponents = buildPaperComponentNodes({
+    topicTree: inputs.officialTopicTreeDraft,
+    rawSectionMap,
+    generatedAt,
+    paths,
+  })
+  const syllabusTopics = buildSyllabusTopicNodes({
+    topicTree: inputs.officialTopicTreeDraft,
+    rawSectionMap,
+    generatedAt,
+    paths,
+  })
+  const syllabusObjectives = buildSyllabusObjectiveNodes({
+    topicTree: inputs.officialTopicTreeDraft,
+    topicNodeMap,
+    rawSectionMap,
+    generatedAt,
+    paths,
+  })
+  const assessmentObjectives = buildAssessmentObjectiveNodes({
+    rawSectionMap,
+    generatedAt,
+    paths,
+  })
+  const fixtures = buildFixtures({
+    objectiveNodes: syllabusObjectives,
+    generatedAt,
+  })
+  const sourceArtifactInventory = buildSourceArtifactInventory(paths, root, inputs)
+  const sourceContract = buildSourceContract(paths, inputs, sourceArtifactInventory)
+  const officialAlignmentNodeCount =
+    paperComponents.length + syllabusTopics.length + syllabusObjectives.length + assessmentObjectives.length
+  const acceptedQuestionAlignmentAssertionCount = fixtures.cases
+    .filter((item) => item.assertion?.status === 'accepted').length
+
+  const alignmentLayer = {
+    schema_version: 'semantic_kg_official_syllabus_alignment_layer.v1',
+    generated_at: generatedAt,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: 1334,
+    parent_issue: 1313,
+    depends_on_issues: [1314, 1315, 1333, 1317, 1316],
+    subject_code: SUBJECT_CODE,
+    objective:
+      'Seed official Cambridge 9709 component/topic/objective/AO alignment nodes before semantic candidate generation.',
+    boundary: buildBoundary(),
+    source_contract: sourceContract,
+    source_artifact_inventory: sourceArtifactInventory,
+    alignment_assertion_contract: buildAlignmentAssertionContract(),
+    seed_nodes: {
+      paper_components: paperComponents,
+      syllabus_topics: syllabusTopics,
+      syllabus_objectives: syllabusObjectives,
+      assessment_objectives: assessmentObjectives,
+    },
+    summary: {
+      paper_component_count: paperComponents.length,
+      syllabus_topic_count: syllabusTopics.length,
+      syllabus_objective_count: syllabusObjectives.length,
+      assessment_objective_count: assessmentObjectives.length,
+      official_alignment_node_count: officialAlignmentNodeCount,
+      question_alignment_fixture_count: fixtures.cases.length,
+      accepted_question_alignment_assertion_count: acceptedQuestionAlignmentAssertionCount,
+      seed_node_status_counts: [...paperComponents, ...syllabusTopics, ...syllabusObjectives, ...assessmentObjectives]
+        .reduce((counts, node) => {
+          counts[node.status] = (counts[node.status] ?? 0) + 1
+          return counts
+        }, {}),
+      external_model_call_count: 0,
+      remote_supabase_mutation_performed: false,
+      production_rag_reindex_performed: false,
+    },
+  }
+
+  const validatorResult = validateAlignmentLayer({
+    alignmentLayer,
+    fixtures,
+    inputDiagnostics,
+  })
+  const readback = buildReadback({
+    alignmentLayer,
+    fixtures,
+    validatorResult,
+  })
+
+  return {
+    alignmentLayer,
+    fixtures,
+    validatorResult,
+    readback,
+    paths,
+  }
+}
+
+export function writeSemanticKgOfficialSyllabusAlignmentLayerArtifacts({
+  outRoot,
+  artifacts,
+  paths = artifacts.paths ?? DEFAULT_PATHS,
+} = {}) {
+  const targetRoot = outRoot ?? repoRootFromScript()
+  writeJson(targetRoot, paths.alignmentOut, artifacts.alignmentLayer)
+  writeJson(targetRoot, paths.fixturesOut, artifacts.fixtures)
+  writeJson(targetRoot, paths.validatorOut, artifacts.validatorResult)
+  writeText(targetRoot, paths.readbackOut, artifacts.readback)
+}
